name: ima-share-sync
description: Windows Obsidian plugin for syncing IMA articles and permitted original files, with local PDF-to-Markdown conversion.

scripts.test:ps: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-sync.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-general.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-general-folders.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-list-readiness.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-original-file-safety.ps1
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:js && npm run test:pdf && npm run test:markdown && npm run test:ps && npm run test:card
scripts.check: npm run verify:release && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
